name: Cuyahoga Valley National Park
tagline: Near-city towpath day — flat canal path and easy nature stops.
blurb: Midwest national park day — towpath miles without a flight out west.

practical.ticket_note: Generally free entry; some sites may have separate fees.
practical.transit_note: Between Cleveland and Akron; Peninsula is a classic hub.
practical.energy_note: Flat towpath is stroller- and little-kid friendly.
practical.best_start: Peninsula / visitor info → towpath stretch → waterfall or boardwalk if nearby
practical.season_note: Year-round; muddy after rain; beautiful fall color.
